segments.he: עִקַּר הַגְדָּלַת כְּבוֹדוֹ הוּא עַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה
segments.en: Every person comes into this world only for this purpose: to perform birurim [refinements] — to refine the holy sparks that have fallen into the depths of the kelipas through the sin of Adam HaRishon, or through his own sins committed in a previous incarnation. And the refining of the sparks is the aspect of converts and penitents, as described above. Therefore a person must guard himself very much and judge himself at all times — to arouse the fire of mishpat described above, to subdue and humble the evil that clings around those sparks he is obliged to refine, so that they do not take hold of him, Heaven forbid.

segments.he: עִקַּר הַגְדָּלַת כְּבוֹדוֹ הוּא עַל יְדֵי תְּפִלָּה שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה רוֹאִין נִפְלְאוֹתָיו הָעֲצוּמִים בְּיוֹתֵר וְזֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ שֶׁל הַתְּפִלָּה גִּלּוּ לָנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ. וְהָרִאשׁוֹן הָיָה אַבְרָהָם שֶׁיָּגַע וְטָרַח בַּעֲבוֹדָתוֹ מְאד וְשִׁבֵּר וּבִטֵּל כָּל תַּאֲוֹתָיו. וּמָסַר נַפְשׁוֹ בִּשְׁבִילוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ כָּל יָמָיו. וְהִרְבָּה בִּתְפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים מְאד עַד שֶׁהִמְשִׁיךְ דֶּרֶךְ הַתְּפִלָּה בָּעוֹלָם וְתִקֵּן לָנוּ תְּפִלַּת שַׁחֲרִית. וְכֵן אַחַר כָּךְ בָּא יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקב וְתִקְּנוּ יוֹתֵר תְּפִלַּת מִנְחָה וּמַעֲרִיב. וְכֵן כָּל הַצַּדִּיקִים הָאֲמִתִּיִּים שֶׁאַחֲרֵיהֶם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה. כֻּלָּם הָלְכוּ בְּדַרְכֵיהֶם וְחִזְּקוּ אוֹתָנוּ לְהַרְבּוֹת בִּתְפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים וְאָנוּ צְרִיכִים לְבַטֵּל דַּעְתֵּנוּ הַפְּחוּתָה וְהַחֲסֵרָה מְאד וְלֵילֵךְ בְּדַרְכֵיהֶם שֶׁל אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְרַבּוֹתֵינוּ לְהַרְבּוֹת בִּתְפִלָּה עַל כָּל דָּבָר וּלְהַאֲמִין שֶׁיֵּשׁ כּחַ בְּיָדֵינוּ לְנַצֵּחַ אוֹתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ לַהֲפךְ דַּעְתּוֹ מִדִּין לְרַחֲמִים אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהָבִין כָּל זֶה אַף עַל פִּי כֵן הָאֱמֶת הוּא כֵּן. וְזֶה עִקַּר הַגְדָּלַת כְּבוֹדוֹ בִּשְׁלֵמוּת כַּנַּ"ל. (הִלְכוֹת תְּפִלַּת הַמִּנְחָה הֲלָכָה ו אוֹת א):
segments.en: For this reason a person is truly in great danger in this world and must judge himself greatly each and every day, reckoning his ways and arousing his heart to Hashem — this is the matter of hisbodidus and conversation between oneself and one's Maker, which Rabbainu of blessed memory warned us about countless times, and which is mentioned many times in his holy books. For according to the very intensity of the danger that faces every person in this world, from great to small, due to the evil that clings to the sparks he must refine — since even the most humble of Yisrael is also performing refinements according to his level, and since these holy sparks are intermixed within the evil — therefore great dangers surround him lest the evil take hold of him, Heaven forbid. Therefore our Rabbis of blessed memory said: Every day a person's evil inclination overcomes him, and were it not for the Holy One blessed be He who helps him... And therefore there is no wisdom and no understanding and no counsel to stand against them except through hisbodidus, which is the aspect of mishpat — that a person must judge himself daily, seclude himself between himself and his Maker, judge his ways, chastise himself, and rebuke himself day after day, in order to arouse the fire of mishpat described above, to burn away and subdue the evil so it does not take hold of his heart.
